description: A state agency created to protect a military base is now the vehicle behind a proposed 40,000-acre data center in Box Elder County. No elected official controls it directly. Here is what MIDA is, how it changed, and why I believe it needs an audit.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Campaign to Elect Cory Maloy
title: What Is MIDA? The Unelected Agency Behind the Box Elder Data Center | The 52 Report
